newsitem.title: USA: Dreyfus names new fund manager, research director.
newsitem.headline: Dreyfus names new fund manager, research director.

text.p: Dreyfus Corp. said Thursday it named Timothy Ghriskey as portfolio manager of the Dreyfus Fund Inc.
Dreyfus, one of the nation's largest mutual fund companies, with more than $85 billion in 150 mutual funds, also named Richard Hoey as director of equity research.
Ghriskey will replace Ernest Wiggins, who will move to Equitable Securities. Wiggins was portfolio manager and director of equity research for the firm.
